exact_responses.help: Try: hello, joke, riddle, motivate me, time, date, or tell me your name!

en: Hey there! 👋 Great to see you.
Hello! How can I help you today?
Hi! I'm {bot_name}, your friendly rule-based assistant.
roman: Walaikum assalam! Kaise ho? 😊
Hey! Kya haal hai?
Salam! Main {bot_name} hoon, batao kya madad kar sakta hoon.

en: I'm just a set of if-else rules, but I'm running smoothly! And you?
Doing great, thanks for asking! What about you?
roman: Main theek hoon, shukriya! Aap sunao?
Sab acha hai mera! Aap kaisay hain?

en: My name is {bot_name}.
roman: Mera naam {bot_name} hai.

en: You're very welcome! 😊
Anytime! Happy to help.
No problem at all!
roman: Koi baat nahi, khushi hui madad karke!
Welcome! Jab bhi zaroorat ho, batana.

en: I can chat with you, tell jokes, share riddles, motivate you for study or work, tell the time/date, do simple math, and remember your name. Try saying 'joke', 'riddle', 'motivate me for study', or just say hi!
Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs! 🐛
I told my computer I needed a break, and it said: 'No problem, I'll go to sleep.' 💤
Why did the if-statement break up with the loop? It just couldn't commit. 😄
Why do Python programmers wear glasses? Because they don't C. 🐍
I'd tell you a UDP joke, but you might not get it.
There are only 10 types of people in the world: those who understand binary and those who don't.
A SQL query walks into a bar, walks up to two tables and asks: 'Can I join you?'
Why did the developer go broke? Because he used up all his cache.
I changed my password to 'incorrect' so whenever I forget it, my computer tells me 'your password is incorrect.'
Why was the JavaScript developer sad? Because he didn't Node how to Express himself.
How many programmers does it take to change a light bulb? None — that's a hardware problem.
My code doesn't have bugs, it just develops random features.
I was made by Areeba, a software developer.
roman: Mujhe Areeba, ek software developer, ne banaya hai.

en: Aww, thank you! I'm just following well-designed rules though 😄
That means a lot! Logic and clarity are my whole personality.
roman: Shukriya! Aap bhi kamal ho 😊
Bohat shukriya, aap ki baat se din ban gaya!

en: That's alright — I'm a simple rule-based system, still learning to grow smarter!
Ouch! I'll do my best to improve.
roman: Koi baat nahi, main abhi seekh raha hoon!

en: I don't have live weather access in this version — I'm rule-based, not connected to the internet! But I'd guess... probably sunny somewhere. ☀️
roman: Mujhe live mausam ka pata nahi chal sakta, main internet se connected nahi hoon abhi!

en: Let's fix that! Want a joke, a riddle, or some motivation?
Bored? Say 'joke' or 'riddle' and let's have some fun.
roman: Chalo bore hona band karte hain! Joke sunun ya paheli?

en: Good night! Sleep well. 🌙
Take care! Talk soon.
roman: Shab bakhair! Acha sona.
Apna khayal rakhna!

riddles.question: I have keys but no locks, space but no room, you can enter but not go inside. What am I?
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
What has to be broken before you can use it?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?
The more you remove from me, the bigger I get. What am I?
What has hands but cannot clap?
I'm tall when I'm young and short when I'm old. What am I?
What has a head and a tail but no body?
What gets wetter as it dries?
What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?

study: "An investment in knowledge pays the best interest." — Benjamin Franklin. Keep going, this exam is temporary but the skill stays forever.
"It always seems impossible until it's done." — Nelson Mandela. One page at a time, you've got this.
"Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out." — Robert Collier. Every study session counts.
"The expert in anything was once a beginner." Keep showing up for your studies, even the hard chapters.
"Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going." — Sam Levenson. One more topic and you're closer to done.
work: "Do the best you can until you know better. Then when you know better, do better." — Maya Angelou. Keep pushing forward.
"The only way to do great work is to love what you do." — Steve Jobs. Take a breath and get back to it — you're closer than you think.
"Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard." — Tim Notke. You've got this shift covered.
"Opportunities don't happen, you create them." — Chris Grosser. Keep building.
"Quality is not an act, it is a habit." — Aristotle. Small consistent effort wins.
general: "It always seems impossible until it's done." — Nelson Mandela.
"Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out." — Robert Collier.
"Well done is better than well said." — Benjamin Franklin.
"You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great." — Zig Ziglar.
custom: Whatever you're working through with {topic}, take it one step at a time — you're more capable than you think.
Keep going with {topic}. Progress isn't always visible day to day, but it adds up.
You've handled hard things before, and {topic} is no different — you've got this.
Small steps still count. Keep showing up for {topic}, even on the slow days.

en: I don't understand that yet — I'm rule-based, so I only know what I've been taught! Try 'help'.
Hmm, that's outside my rule set. Could you rephrase, or type 'help' to see what I can do?
I'm not sure how to respond to that. My logic doesn't cover it yet!
roman: Mujhe yeh samajh nahi aaya — main rule-based hoon, sirf wahi jaanta hoon jo sikhaya gaya hai! 'help' likh kar dekho.
Yeh mere rules se bahar hai. Dobara try karo ya 'help' likho.

en: Goodbye! It was great chatting with you. 👋
See you soon! Take care.
Bye! Come back anytime.
roman: Allah Hafiz! Phir milte hain.
Khuda hafiz, bohat maza aya baat kar ke!
